critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/leads has no email format validation (LeadCreate uses str not EmailStr). Frontend validates, but API accepts any string. Low priority for current scope (WA-only flow).
server.py: No rate-limiting / dedupe on /api/leads or /api/cta — spam risk in public landing page.
Admin page has NO authentication (per product choice) — exposes /admin and all leads & delete to anyone with the URL. Document this as an accepted risk.
LeadForm.jsx mirrors lead data to localStorage (gk_leads) — fine, but be aware it persists PII on user device.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — switch to lifespan handler (not blocking).
